battle.name: 俄法戰爭
battle.brief: 一八一二年六月二十四日，拿破崙率大軍越過涅曼河東進，企圖逼亞歷山大一世重回大陸封鎖體系。戰事由斯摩棱斯克、博羅季諾燒到莫斯科城，最後以別列津納河渡口崩潰收場。俄軍全程避免會戰，改以焦土與平行撤退耗敵。輪發槍在法軍序列中僅餘於警衛與軍官備用手槍位，近身戰鬥全由燧發手槍承擔。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 法蘭西帝國及其體系內的附庸與盟軍是進攻方。一八一二年六月二十四日，拿破崙一世自波蘭與立陶宛越過涅曼河，率領所謂大軍（Grande Armée）東進。核心是法國本身的近衛軍、二十四個步兵軍團與騎兵預備軍；同盟方面有萊茵同盟各邦——巴伐利亞王國、符騰堡王國、薩克森王國、威斯特伐利亞王國、華沙公國、義大利王國、那不勒斯王國與丹麥挪威——以及被迫參與的普魯士分遣隊，盟軍合計在五萬人上下。軍團序列中可以點名的是達武的第三軍、烏迪諾的第五軍、涅伊的第六軍、儒爾的第九軍、奧古斯特的第八軍、莫蒂埃的第十二軍、波拿波的波蘭軍團、馬克唐的第十軍，以及繆拉統率的騎兵預備軍與格魯希的第三騎兵軍；義大利方面另有由歐仁親王博哈奈斯指揮的義大利軍團。俄羅斯帝國是防守方：西部第一西方軍原由巴爾克拉耶·德·托利統帥，五月底由庫圖佐夫接任；第二西方軍由巴格拉基昂率領；第三後備觀察軍由托爾馬索夫在南部組建；另有普拉通的哥薩克軍、烏瓦羅夫的騎兵近衛軍、分布全國的獵兵與地方民兵，以及後方日益活躍的游擊隊。指揮體系上，拿破崙自任全軍最高指揮，參謀長為貝爾蒂埃，縱隊與後勤由達武、波拿波等人分掌；俄軍以第一軍為骨幹，庫圖佐夫以舊俄式參謀總部運作，戰術決策權高度集中於他一人之手。
countriesEn: The attacking side was the French Empire together with its satellite states and allies. On 24 June 1812 Napoleon I crossed the Niemen in Poland and Lithuania at the head of what was called the Grande Armée. The core was the French army itself: the Imperial Guard, twenty-four infantry corps and a cavalry reserve. Alongside France came the states of the Confederation of the Rhine — the Kingdoms of Bavaria, Württemberg, Saxony and Westphalia, the Duchy of Warsaw, the Kingdoms of Italy and Naples, and Denmark-Norway — plus a coerced Prussian detachment, the allied contingents together amounting to some fifty thousand men. The corps that can be named individually are Davout's III, Oudinot's V, Ney's VI, Junot's IX, Augereau's VIII, Mortier's XII, Poniatowski's Polish corps, Macdonald's X, and Murat's cavalry reserve together with Grouchy's III Cavalry Corps; in Italy, Eugène de Beauharnais commanded the Army of Italy. On the defensive side stood the Russian Empire. The 1st Western Army in the west was originally led by Barclay de Tolly and was taken over by Kutuzov at the end of May; the 2nd Western Army was Bagration's; the 3rd Reserve Army of Observation was raised in the south by Tormasov; besides these came Platov's Cossack Host, Uvarov's cavalry of the Guard, Jaeger and militia formations scattered across the empire, and a partisan movement that grew steadily in the rear. On the French side Napoleon was commander-in-chief with Berthier as chief of staff, the line and the rear area shared among Davout, Poniatowski and others; on the Russian side the 1st Western Army formed the backbone, Kutuzov worked through the old Russian-style general staff, and tactical authority was concentrated almost entirely in his own hands.
people: 拿破崙一世是全場戰爭的軸心。他自任大軍最高指揮，帶同貝爾蒂埃參謀長與一群元帥作戰；他以為戰役可以速戰速決，途中不斷調整部署，從波蘭一路打到莫斯科，再折返打往別列津納。元帥之中，達武率第三軍沿波羅的海方向迂迴，一八一二年六月二十八日取下明斯克，並以一個軍團屢次拖住整支俄軍；烏迪諾與涅伊的軍團自維爾納向東推進，涅伊在維捷布斯克與俄軍前哨血戰，卻沒能壓住巴格拉基昂；繆拉率騎兵預備軍在博羅季諾投入了法軍規模最大的一次騎兵突擊；莫蒂埃帶領新開到的「青年近衛」；波拿波把波蘭軍團留在掩護位置，勉力帶回殘部退入普魯士，翌年在萊比錫陣亡。俄方人數雖少，指揮效率卻更高。巴爾克拉耶·德·托利在五月初接手第一軍時採取平行行軍，避免被各個擊破；巴格拉基昂在斯摩棱斯克與維捷布斯克之間以主動襲擊拖住法軍；庫圖佐夫自五月底接任第一軍後採取「不戰而屈敵兵」的方針，主張始終避免會戰、把法軍引向深處，等它因糧秣、馬匹與士氣崩潰，最後只在莫斯科城下與別列津納河打兩次殘酷的消耗戰。第九軍與直屬部隊的多克圖羅夫在十月十二日的小雅羅斯拉維茨擋住法軍退路；普拉通率哥薩克不斷襲擊法軍側後；托爾馬索夫在南部吸住敵軍，使德國方向得以空出。工兵主任耶爾莫拉耶夫在別列津納河搶建浮橋；拉雷醫生以飛舟式救護隊在博羅季諾與撤退路上搶救傷員；丹尼先·達維多夫、塞斯拉文與費格涅爾等游擊隊首領則在後方遊擊，切斷補給線。亞歷山大一世自居「解放者」，在聖彼得堡遙控整場戰役。
peopleEn: Napoleon I was the axis of the whole war. He took command of the Grande Armée himself, with Berthier as chief of staff and a host of marshals around him; he believed the campaign could be decided quickly, reshuffled his deployments as he went, marched from Poland all the way to Moscow and then fought back toward the Berezina. Among the marshals, Davout led the III Corps in a movement along the Baltic shore, took Minsk on 28 June 1812 and held off the entire Russian army with a single corps on more than one occasion; Oudinot's and Ney's corps advanced east from Vilna, and Ney fought the Russian outposts at Vitebsk without pinning Bagration down. Murat led the cavalry reserve in the largest mounted charge the French mounted in this campaign, at Borodino; Mortier brought up the newly arrived Young Guard; Poniatowski kept his Polish corps in covering positions and managed to withdraw the remnants into Prussia, where he was killed a year later at Leipzig. The Russians were fewer in number but far more efficient in command. Barclay de Tolly took over the 1st Army in early May and marched in parallel so as not to be defeated in detail; Bagration fought a running rearguard action between Smolensk and Vitebsk to keep the French engaged; Kutuzov, who assumed command of the 1st Army at the end of May, pursued a policy of defeating the enemy without a battle, refusing to engage, drawing the French deeper, and waiting for their supply, horses and morale to break, so that only at Moscow and on the Berezina did he fight two bitter consuming actions. Dokhturov's IX Corps and the direct detachments blocked the French withdrawal route at Maloyaroslavets on 12 October; Platov's Cossacks harried the French flanks and rear continuously; Tormasov held the south and left the German direction free. The engineering director Yermolayev rushed a pontoon bridge into place over the Berezina; the doctor Larrey worked his flying ambulance to recover the wounded at Borodino and along the retreat road; partisan leaders such as Denis Davydov, Seslavin and Figner operated behind the French lines and cut the supply routes. Alexander I presented himself as the liberator and directed the entire war from Saint Petersburg.
kits: 輪發槍在這場戰爭裡的位置是「遺產」而不是「主力」。輪發機制是最早的後膛自擊發手槍方案，代價是零件昂貴、組裝耗時，機簧在潮濕天氣裡點火遲緩；到一八一二年，燧發手槍早已全面取代它。因此輪發槍只剩零星配備於少數近衛與警衛單位，以及軍官與士官的備用手槍位，儀式與備用的成分多於實戰。大軍真正攜帶並開火的是法軍制式火器：安十一式（即一七七七年型、一八〇三年改進）滑膛燧發步槍，以及後來配發的一八一一型十二發滑膛步槍，輕步兵用一七九四年式，騎兵用卡賓槍與騎兵手槍，軍官另配蘭伯特式單發手槍；炮兵仍是格里博瓦爾體系的四磅與六磅野戰炮、十二磅團屬炮，配騎兵炮與二十四磅攻城炮。俄軍的裝備同樣是滑膛燧發步槍，以一七九六式為主並已配發一八〇七式，配圓形鉛彈與紙包定裝藥，軍中普遍以定裝藥取代散裝火藥，裝填較慢，但在雨雪之中較不易受潮失效；獵兵連使用精度稍佳的輕型槍，騎兵裝備卡賓槍、手槍與矛，哥薩克以卡賓槍、彎刀、套索鞭與長矛作戰。攻城方面是浮橋便攜舟橋、壕溝挖掘工具與攻城砲；後勤方面是法軍龐大的貨車隊、數以萬計的挽馬與牛、帳篷與炊事車、火藥彈藥箱以及約四十五磅的步兵背囊。真正決定勝負的裝備是馬匹：數十萬匹挽馬在缺草料與嚴寒之中大量倒斃，帶走的不只是騎乘功能，還有法軍賴以快速機動的整個騎兵與炮兵體系。
kitsEn: The wheellock's place in this war was that of a legacy rather than a main arm. The wheellock action is the earliest self-igniting breech-loading pistol system, and its costs are high: expensive parts, slow assembly, and a spring-driven igniter that misfires or hangs in wet weather. By 1812 the flintlock pistol had completely superseded it. The wheellock therefore survived only in scattered issue to a few guard and picked units, and as a sidearm held in reserve by officers and NCOs — more parade and standby than fighting. The weapons the Grande Armée actually carried and fired were the standard French military arms: the An XI smoothbore flintlock musket, that is the 1777 pattern as revised in 1803, together with the 1811-pattern twelve-shot smoothbore musket issued later; light infantry used the 1794 pattern; cavalry carried carbines and cavalry pistols, officers the single-shot Lambert flintlock pistol. The artillery was still the Gribeauval system: four- and six-pounder field guns, twelve-pounder brigade guns, horse artillery and twenty-four-pounder siege pieces. The Russian armament was likewise smoothbore flintlock muskets, the 1796 pattern predominating with the 1807 pattern already in distribution, firing round lead ball and paper cartridges. The Russians generally used made-up cartridges instead of loose powder, which was slower to load but far less liable to fail in rain and snow. Jaeger companies were armed with a more accurate light musket; cavalry carried carbines, pistols and lances; Cossacks fought with carbines, sabres, nagaika whips and lances. For siege work there were portable pontoon boats, trench tools and siege artillery. In the logistic train the French had an enormous wagon park, tens of thousands of draught horses and oxen, tents and cooking wagons, ammunition boxes, and infantry knapsacks of about forty-five pounds. The equipment that truly decided the outcome was the horses: tens of thousands of draught animals died of missing fodder and severe cold, and what went down with them was not merely the means of riding but the entire mounted and artillery system on which French mobility depended.
tactics: 法軍一八一二年的計畫是典型的分進合擊：達武第三軍沿北線取明斯克，烏迪諾與涅伊的第六軍向維捷布斯克施壓，主力中央縱隊經斯摩棱斯克推進，企圖把俄軍壓成一團決戰。俄軍不吃這一套：第一、第二西方軍在相距數十公里的兩條平行線上後撤，避免被分割；第二軍的巴格拉基昂在斯摩棱斯克與維捷布斯克之間主動打游擊式的邊打邊退，七月下旬與第一軍會合；沿途執行焦土，把村莊、穀物與乾草全部焚毀，使法軍的徵糧隊回報「一無所有」。九月七日博羅季諾，拿破崙照例要求正面強攻：謝瓦爾季諾與拉耶夫斯基兩座土壘是俄軍陣地的骨架，法軍以縱隊連續衝擊，格拉沃德大壘兩翼反覆易手；「火焰之冠」炮兵群的齊射把俄軍前沿犁平；繆拉的騎兵預備隊在兩翼反覆衝擊，烏瓦羅夫的縱隊反過來插入法軍突出部，把戰役從正面戰拖成一日以上的消耗戰。庫圖佐夫多次拒絕主動出擊，只令哥薩克擾擾法軍側翼；法軍既未能包抄，也未能把俄軍打散，戰役遂成僵局。十月十九日撤出莫斯科之後，退路戰開始：小雅羅斯拉維茨在十月十二日以多克圖羅夫的第三預備軍卡住卡盧加方向；十一月十五至十八日克拉斯諾依的後衛戰又吃掉法軍第十一軍與第二軍的大量兵力；十一月二十六至二十九日的別列津納河，浮橋被冰層壓斷、道路被雪堆堵塞，掉隊的病員、輜重與後衛部隊被俄軍在岸上分割殲滅。俄軍戰術的要點始終是三件事：保存主力、斷敵後方、把戰爭拖進冬天。游擊隊的實踐更在後方寫下教科書：丹尼先·達維多夫的小隊在道路上伏擊法軍護送隊、燒毀倉庫與郵件車，使法軍的糧秣與通訊系統迅速崩潰。同一套方法在一八一三至一八一四年的德國戰場被原樣搬用，成為俄軍「以時間換空間」的標準戰術。
tacticsEn: The French plan for 1812 was a classic converging offensive. Davout's III Corps took Minsk on the northern axis, Oudinot's and Ney's VI Corps pressed toward Vitebsk, and the central columns of the main body advanced through Smolensk, all aimed at compressing the Russians into a single decisive battle. The Russians declined to play along. The 1st and 2nd Western Armies withdrew along two parallel lines scores of kilometres apart, so as not to be defeated piecemeal. Bagration's 2nd Army fought a partisan running action between Smolensk and Vitebsk, and joined the 1st Army in late July. Along the route they carried out a scorched-earth policy, burning villages, grain and hay so that the French foraging parties reported back that there was nothing to be found. At Borodino on 7 September Napoleon demanded the frontal attack as usual. The Shevardino and Raevsky redoubts were the framework of the Russian position; the French attacked them with successive columns, and the flanks of the Great Redoubt changed hands repeatedly. The battery known as the crown of fires flattened the Russian front with massed fire; Murat's cavalry reserve charged again and again on both flanks; Uvarov's column thrust back into the French salient, turning the engagement from a frontal battle into a consuming struggle lasting more than a day. Kutuzov refused to attack repeatedly, ordering only his Cossacks to harass the French flanks and rear. Unable to outflank and unable to break the Russians, the French saw the battle end in a stalemate. After the evacuation of Moscow on 19 October the war of the retreat began. At Maloyaroslavets on 12 October Dokhturov's 3rd Reserve Army closed the Kaluga road. The rearguard action at Krasnoi from 15 to 18 November again cost the French the 11th and 2nd Corps heavily. At the Berezina from 26 to 29 November the pontoon bridges were crushed by the ice and the roads choked with snowdrifts, and the stragglers, the wounded and the baggage train were cut up and destroyed on the banks by the Russians. The essence of Russian method was always threefold: preserve the main army, cut the enemy off from his rear, and drag the war into winter. The partisans wrote the manual in the enemy's rear: Denis Davydov's bands ambushed French escort columns on the roads and burned depots and mail wagons, so that the French supply and communications system collapsed quickly. The same methods were transplanted unchanged to Germany in 1813 and 1814 and became the standard Russian doctrine of buying time with space.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。進攻前大軍連同盟軍約六十一萬人，馬匹約二十五萬匹（有統計作十八萬七千匹），野戰炮約一千二百至一千四百門；俄軍在西部可用兵力約二十萬至二十五萬，第一軍約十二萬至十五萬，第二軍約四萬九千，第三後備軍約四萬三千，另有哥薩克與民兵。維捷布斯克之戰（七月二十八日）涅伊損失約一千五百至三千人；斯摩棱斯克之戰（八月二至六日）雙方傷亡各以數千計。九月七日博羅季諾，法軍與盟軍約十三萬人、俄軍約十二萬人，雙方火炮都在六百門上下；俄軍陣亡重傷約四萬至四萬五千，法軍及盟軍合計損失約三萬上下，法方公布的數字則由二萬八千至五萬不等，雙方史家至今各執一詞。九月十四日進入莫斯科的軍隊逾十萬人；火勢燒毀約七成市區，拿破崙在城內停留三十六日，至十月十九日才啟程西返。行軍距離方面，從涅曼河到莫斯科約一千公里，整個役程每名士兵平均行程估計超過二千五百公里。別列津納一役，法軍損失一萬二千至三萬人（俄方傳統說法指兩萬八千）。撤退途中天氣在十一月中下旬急轉直下，十一月二十八日拿破崙在斯莫爾貢的測溫計記下攝氏零下二十八度，零下的夜裡常低至二十五度以下。十二月中下旬主力重新渡過涅曼河，最後一批法軍在年底之前離開俄國；大軍總損失約三十萬至五十萬人，其中二十餘萬人陣亡、重傷與被俘，二十餘萬人逃散失聯，馬匹倒斃逾二十萬匹。俄軍的損失同樣慘重，估計逾十萬至二十萬人，但大部分不是死在戰鬥，而是死於冬季的飢餓、斑疹傷寒與壞血病。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Before the invasion the Grande Armée with its allies numbered about six hundred and ten thousand men, with about two hundred and fifty thousand horses (one computation gives one hundred and eighty-seven thousand), and some twelve hundred to fourteen hundred field guns. The Russians had between two hundred and two hundred and fifty thousand men available in the west: some one hundred and twenty to one hundred and fifty thousand in the 1st Army, forty-nine thousand in the 2nd, forty-three thousand in the 3rd Reserve Army, plus Cossacks and militia. At the battle of Vitebsk on 28 July Ney lost roughly fifteen hundred to three thousand men; at Smolensk from 2 to 6 August casualties on both sides ran into the thousands. At Borodino on 7 September the French and their allies had about one hundred and thirty thousand men against about one hundred and twenty thousand Russians, with something like six hundred guns on each side. Russian dead and wounded came to some forty to forty-five thousand, and the French and allied losses together to around thirty thousand, though French published figures run from twenty-eight thousand to fifty thousand and historians on both sides still argue the point. More than one hundred thousand men entered Moscow on 14 September; fire destroyed roughly seventy per cent of the city, and Napoleon stayed thirty-six days before setting out west on 19 October. As for distance, some one thousand kilometres separate the Niemen from Moscow, and the average soldier covered more than two thousand five hundred kilometres over the campaign. At the Berezina the French lost between twelve and thirty thousand men, the traditional Russian figure being twenty-eight thousand. The weather turned during the second half of November: on 28 November Napoleon's own thermometer at Smorgoni read twenty-eight degrees below zero Celsius, and on clear nights it often fell below minus twenty-five. The main body recrossed the Niemen in the second half of December and the last French troops left Russian territory before the year ended. Total losses from the Grande Armée ran from three hundred to five hundred thousand men, of whom more than two hundred and fifty thousand were killed, wounded or captured and more than two hundred and fifty thousand went missing or deserted, and over two hundred thousand horses died. Russian losses were grave as well, estimated at more than one hundred and two hundred thousand, but most of them were not battle deaths: they died of hunger, typhus and scurvy in the winter.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是經濟與外交：拿破崙的大陸封鎖體系要靠俄國配合才能運作，而亞歷山大一世自一八〇七年起限制與英國的穀物貿易，一八一二年初法方要求俄國正式加入封鎖並切斷對英的一切往來，朝廷拿不定主意而拖延應酬，六月談判終於破裂，法軍越過涅曼河本身就等於宣戰。第二層是拿破崙的戰略誤判：他以為俄軍會像普魯士或奧地利那樣在幾次敗仗之後派出代表求和，以為只要一場決戰就能迫使沙皇認輸；他計畫在一八一二年的夏天解決戰事，讓軍隊在秋天回到巴黎做英雄，他不知道俄軍的戰略前提恰恰是「不打」。第三層是俄方的選擇：庫圖佐夫主張不與法軍會戰，讓它深入、讓它拉長、讓它餓；沙皇把戰爭呈現成全民族的「一八一二年」保衛戰，以正當性換時間，用土地與糧秣的損失換取主力完整。背景還有兩項：法軍自一八〇八年以來在西班牙被拖住，英國的封鎖又切斷了法國的海外收入；而一八一二年四月的法俄同盟條約把普魯士綁在法國的戰車上，使這場戰爭在爆發時看起來不會有其他歐洲國家插手。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The first was economic and diplomatic. Napoleon's Continental System only functioned if Russia cooperated, and Alexander I had restricted grain exports to Britain from 1807. In early 1812 the French demanded that Russia formally join the blockade and cut every contact with Britain; the court dithered and stalled, the June talks broke down, and the crossing of the Niemen was itself the declaration of war. The second layer was Napoleon's strategic miscalculation. He expected the Russians to behave like the Prussians or the Austrians and to send emissaries for peace after a few lost battles, and he believed a single decisive action would force the tsar to give in. He planned to settle the whole business in the summer of 1812 and bring the army back to Paris in the autumn to be a hero. He did not grasp that the premise of Russian strategy was precisely not to fight. The third layer was the Russian choice. Kutuzov argued for avoiding any battle: let the French come deeper, let the lines stretch, let them go hungry. The tsar presented the war as a nationwide 1812 defence of the fatherland, buying time with legitimacy and trading land and grain to keep the main army intact. Two further conditions formed the background. The French had been bogged down in Spain since 1808, and the British blockade was cutting off France's overseas revenue. And the Franco-Russian alliance treaty of April 1812 tied Prussia to Napoleon's cart, so that at the moment the war opened there was no sign of other European powers intervening.
impact: 直接後果是拿破崙體系的崩解。莫斯科的失敗使普魯士、奧地利、瑞典與英國在一八一三年重新組成聯盟；萊比錫的「民族大會戰」之後，一八一四年拿破崙退位、法蘭西第一共和國覆亡，維也納會議重劃歐洲，並由此進入大約四十年的相對和平。俄羅斯則由戰國的邊陲變成歐洲的仲裁者，亞歷山大一世以「歐洲解放者」的身份登上歷史舞台。軍事上，這場戰爭把兩種教訓刻進了制度：一是後勤與補給決定大規模作戰的勝負，任何依賴戰地徵糧的體系在敵國縱深都撐不久；二是當對方選擇不決戰時，攻擊方的會戰意願與計畫會自己崩潰，焦土、平行撤退與游擊的組合可以把一支百萬級的軍隊拖垮。俄軍在西歐同樣吃了後勤與紀律的苦頭，這說明焦土並非萬靈丹。文化上，「一八一二年」在俄羅斯成為一種長期記憶：羅斯托普欽當年的詩、托爾斯泰《戰爭與和平》對整段戰役與「一八一二年神話」的重新詮釋、二十世紀的戰爭電影，以及一九一二年全國性的百年慶典，都把莫斯科的火與博羅季諾變成共同的民族敘事；法國那邊則把它寫成文明的斷裂，繪畫與文學中不斷出現「大軍覆沒」的主題。在世界範圍內，同年六月美國對英國開戰，把英國的注意力與兵力拉向大西洋的另一端，法國原想趁機打擊英國本土的計劃因此無從實現；而西班牙殖民地戰爭在拿破崙帝國崩潰之後出現真空，直接推動了拉丁美洲的獨立運動，時間點正落在這場戰爭之後的十年之間。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was the disintegration of the Napoleonic system. The failure at Moscow brought Prussia, Austria, Sweden and Britain back together in a coalition in 1813; after Leipzig, the battle of the nations, came the abdication in 1814 and the end of the First French Republic, while the Congress of Vienna redrew Europe and opened a period of roughly forty years of relative peace. Russia moved from the margin of the war to the position of arbiter of Europe, and Alexander I entered history as the liberator of Europe. Militarily the war engraved two lessons into doctrine. First, logistics and supply decide the outcome of large operations: any system that depends on foraging in the field collapses once it operates deep inside enemy country. Second, when the opponent chooses not to fight a set-piece battle, the attacker's appetite and plan for that battle unravel by themselves, and the combination of scorched earth, parallel withdrawal and partisan war can destroy an army of a million men. The Russians suffered from the same problems of logistics and discipline when they campaigned in the West, which shows scorched earth is no universal remedy. Culturally, 1812 became a lasting memory in Russia: Rostopchine's poem written at the time, Tolstoy's reinterpretation of the whole campaign and of the myth of 1812 in War and Peace, twentieth-century war films, and the nationwide centenary of 1912 all turned the fire of Moscow and Borodino into a shared national narrative. In France the same events were written as a rupture of civilisation, and the destroyed Grande Armée became a recurring subject in painting and literature. On a world scale, the United States declared war on Britain in June of the same year, drawing British attention and troops toward the other side of the Atlantic and killing Napoleon's plan to strike at Britain itself; and the collapse of Spain's colonial war after the fall of the Napoleonic empire left a vacuum that drove the independence movements of Latin America, in the decade immediately following this campaign.
result: 結果是俄國的戰略勝利與法軍的物理崩潰。整支大軍在別列津納之後已經不再是一支能作戰的隊伍：十二月中下旬陸續撤過涅曼河的只有數萬殘兵，十一月陣亡於格爾利茨的迪羅克元帥與被俘的將領、隨軍的元帥與大批參謀幕僚陸續回到巴黎，拿破崙本人於十二月十八日踏上法國土地時被告知大軍已不存在。羅斯托普欽寫的《大火的莫斯科》把這場失敗變成一段民族記憶，後來的人則更關心如何重建：一八一三年一月巴黎組成「元帥集團」，以約二萬二千人的規模重新編組倖存者；波拿波的波蘭軍團退入普魯士，最終在萊比錫陣亡；法國開始準備打下一場戰爭。俄軍這邊完整保留了主力，庫圖佐夫在一八一三年率軍越過涅曼河進入德國，攻入法國境內，一八一四年三月十八日進入巴黎，參與了拿破崙的退位。戰爭在戰術層面的結算則是一串殘酷的數字：莫斯科的燃燒、貨車隊的翻覆、嚴寒中的非戰鬥死亡，構成一次以整個帝國的軍隊為代價的教訓課。一八一二年之後，拿破崙戰爭再延續兩年，以一八一四年的《巴黎條約》、拿破崙第一次退位與波旁王朝復辟收場，一八一五年的滑鐵盧與維也納會議則確認了新歐洲的版圖。
resultEn: The result was a Russian strategic victory and the physical disintegration of the French army. After the Berezina the Grande Armée was no longer a force capable of fighting: the tens of thousands who recrossed the Niemen in the second half of December were all that was left. Duroc, who died of his wounds at Görlitz in November, captured generals, the marshals who accompanied the army and a great part of the staff returned to Paris one by one, and when Napoleon himself set foot on French soil on 18 December he was told that the Grande Armée no longer existed. Rostopchine's Fire of Moscow turned the defeat into a national memory, and those who came afterwards were more concerned with rebuilding. In January 1813 Paris formed the Group of the Marshals, reconstituting the survivors on a scale of some twenty-two thousand men; Poniatowski's Polish corps withdrew into Prussia and was destroyed at Leipzig; and France began preparing the next war. On the Russian side the main army came through intact. Kutuzov crossed the Niemen in 1813, drove into Germany and into France, and entered Paris on 18 March 1814 in time to take part in Napoleon's abdication. The tactical settlement of the campaign is a brutal line of numbers: the burning of Moscow, overturned baggage wagons, deaths from cold away from the battlefield — a lesson paid for by the army of an entire empire. The war of 1812 was followed by two more years of Napoleonic war, closed by the Treaty of Paris in 1814, the first abdication and the restoration of the Bourbons, and confirmed by Waterloo in 1815 and the Congress of Vienna, which settled the map of the new Europe.
